title: Which is wider?
statement:
From the same 10,000 bootstrap means you build a 95% CI and a 99% CI. Which statement is true?

[_]{a}

choices: It depends on the random seed
The 99% CI is narrower because it is more precise
The 99% CI is wider and contains the 95% CI
explanations: With the same bootstraps, 0.5–99.5 always contains 2.5–97.5.
More confidence needs a wider range.

solution: The 99% CI uses percentiles 0.5 and 99.5, further out than 2.5 and 97.5, so it is wider and contains the 95% CI.
